sketches.mechanism: Ownership move semantics: passing a non-Copy value transfers it, and any later use of the old binding is a compile-time error.
sketches.resonance: Once the self has been given away, the language refuses to pretend it is still here.

sketches.mechanism: Non-strict evaluation permits an infinite self-referential list, and only the demanded prefix is evaluated.
sketches.resonance: Endlessness can exist as long as the world asks for only one moment at a time.

sketches.mechanism: A revert aborts execution and rolls back all state changes made earlier in the call.
sketches.resonance: The act of leaving is attempted, but history is restored as if it never happened.
